findings.reason: The standalone original tiles contain the two analytic branches and the cutoff outflow formula but no illustration. A characteristic sketch materially clarifies the split a=t, the distinct birth and initial traces, and precisely why only initial ages A-T<=x<A contribute to cutoff outflow. This is an explanatory addition warranted under the expanded diagram scope, rather than a failure of the complete existing proof.
findings.action: Added a time–age TikZ sketch and explanatory paragraph in final Remarks, leaving every original byte intact.

correction: Appended final Remarks with initial-cohort and newborn characteristics, survival-weighted density labels, separator a=t, renewal inflow, absorbing cutoff and the initial exit-age interval.

diagram_math_checks.objects: Time–age plane over 0<=t<=T<A with age speed 1; initial trace at t=0, birth trace at a=0, cutoff a=A.
diagram_math_checks.check: Both solid sample paths have slope +1 with forward-time arrows. In schematic coordinates T=4,A=6, the initial path starts at x=3.5 and reaches a=6 at t=2.5; the newborn path starts at t_b=1 and reaches age 3 at T=4.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Local definition gives age speed 1 and absorbing removal; theorem F1 and proof step 5.1 give the same characteristics.

diagram_math_checks.objects: Initial and newborn density branches and their separator.
diagram_math_checks.check: Initial a=x+t has x>=0 and hence a>=t; newborn a=t-t_b with t_b>0 lies below a=t. The dashed diagonal is exactly the separating a=t characteristic.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Displayed density formula in Statement and substitution in proof step 3.1.

diagram_math_checks.objects: Survival labels on both solid paths.
diagram_math_checks.check: For initial age x, density at elapsed time t is n_0^A(x)S(x,t). For birth time t_b, age is t-t_b and density is B_A(t_b)S(0,t-t_b), obtained from B_A(t-a)S(0,a). All labels agree with the statement and F1 survival law.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Statement density formula, F1, and proof step 3.1; no new survival assertion is introduced.

diagram_math_checks.check: Solving x+t=A gives exit time A-x. Exit by T is A-x<=T, equivalent to x>=A-T, with x<A from the initial age domain. The bracket is annotated A-T<=x<A; it does not assert closed inclusion at A. Initial path terminates at the absorbing line with no continuation above A.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Exact outflow formula and proof step 5.1; definition removes cohorts when they reach A.

diagram_math_checks.objects: Newborn path endpoint at time T.
diagram_math_checks.check: For 0<=t_b<=t<=T, age t-t_b<=T<A, so the newborn sample stops at the right time boundary strictly below the absorbing cutoff. No newborn trajectory is drawn reaching A.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Hypothesis 0<T<A in supplier definition and proof step 5.1.
